reviews.author: Ryan Yea just Ryan.
reviews.text: I feel it's needed to say All In Garage is quite the go-to place for anything. I needed a device calibrated there today, with a deadline, and (I didn't catch her name) the lovely woman who stayed AFTER HOURS made sure that I was all set. Fernando is also great, personable, and I look forward to doing further business with them when the time comes.

reviews.author: Margo Parkerschellerhaaden Taylor
reviews.text: Fixed Dad’s 2018 GMC; he is really impressed with All In and the owner, and wanted to share it with whoever is looking for a fair deal. Thank you for giving my dad a good experience and being kind and fair.

reviews.author: Michael Bennett
reviews.text: I take all of my vehicles, including my motorcycle's to All in Garage because of the consistency of the quality of work and I genuinely trust them to do the work that is needed to be done! Great prices, fantastic work...and locally owned and operated!

reviews.author: F MJ
reviews.text: Very dishonest. Fernando will charge you with unnecessary parts and services that supposedly done. He charged me twice on the same problem separate time and the problem still exist and not working. Contact department of labor and commerce and they recommended file small claim lawsuit. It has evidence that this shop has neglected and broke some of the basics statue they should not have done. They can not execute any services or replace any parts without informing the customer. Fernando straight add up all various charges and parts that he didnt tell me about it I need. i didnt even know what some of the services and problems my vehicle had but he claimed he fix it ...very disappointed and it is hard to find a truly honest mechanic.

reviews.author: DK G
reviews.text: Had a good experience here. Was looking for someone to handle older vehicles and they were the only one I found willing to take on the work. Like most places they seem to have more work than people to do it but I was impressed with their knowledge and willingness to tackle most automotive issues. Prices reflected current dealer work which seemed a bit high but good mechanics are hard to find.

reviews.author: Britney Wilson
reviews.text: Fernando is the best of the best. He’s been my mechanic for about 5 years now and he’s honest, reliable and always does an outstanding job. Overall he’s just a good dude

reviews.author: Lance Silver
reviews.text: Fernando is THE BOMB!! Amazing car shop!!! They stand behind their work. I trust them for all of my cars and trucks!!

reviews.author: Don Kensey
reviews.text: This company is nothing short of the best. I moved into the area several months ago and was concerned about finding a good, reliable mechanic. I’ve used them twice and both times they were thorough, courteous, reliable and professional. Dealing with Fernando and Jai has been a true pleasure. Five stars all the way.

reviews.author: Gary Gehlhoff
reviews.text: Had a first for auto repair shops. Another shop recommended the brakes be replaced. All In Garage said I still had 30 percent left and recommended we delay for a year.an oil pan gasket leak. A pleasant surprise. Very honest. Will definitely have more work done there.The repair was done very well at a reasonable price. Gary Gary

reviews.author: MIchael Bolognese
reviews.text: These guys are awesome! Came in with an issue a no appointment. They're affordable, the shop is super clean and they're very friendly.

reviews.author: Alexandre Barbier
reviews.text: These guys are the best. My girlfriend and I brought them our van which had a weird problem. Other garages had not been able to diagnose it but they found what it was. And when it turned out it was the transmission and it would take two days to fix, they even let us sleep in our van in the back of their garage as we had no place to go and no car. On top of that, the whole team was super friendly and understanding with us (and tolerant, as we spent two whole days in their waiting room). We are now back on the road with our new transmission! If you are in the area and in need of a good mechanic, this is the place to go. Would give them six stars if I could. Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Rick Ortiz
reviews.text: Words cannot express of how fortunate I am to have found this shop. The employees have always been very accommodating, friendly, and straightforward. I have taken my car to All In Garage a handful of times and the service has always been quick and a clean professional job was always done. I highly recommend this shop to anyone who is looking for a genuine honest and professional auto shop. And a big thank you to all the guys at All In Garage!

reviews.author: Jeffrey White
reviews.text: I googled this location for immediate service on my truck that had a check engine light on and was running extremely rough. Fernando and the woman at the desk were very professional, and listened to what my problem was. Within 6 hours I received a phone call from Fernando telling me what the problem was and the best solution at the best price. My truck was then repaired and back up and running 100% by noontime the next day. Fernando literally saved me from having to get a new engine or a new truck. I am very grateful and more than satisfied with their expertise and customer service. I will not go anywhere else at this point.

reviews.author: Sylvanie Johnson
reviews.text: The service given to me was unbelievably the best I have ever had. From the customer service to the technicians, everyone treats you like you are family and work very hard to ensure that the vehicle is restored to good health. I loved every single interaction and would definitely make my way there again! Very commendable service and lovely people!!!

reviews.author: Barry Lory
reviews.text: John & his team are efficient, professional, & friendly. Nice clean shop tells you they'll care for your car as well. Took it upon themselves to drive to Savannah to purchase transmission fluid from dealership that was required to maintain warranty coverage. They could have easily installed standard ATF and called it a day. They care!

reviews.author: John Ryan
reviews.text: Highly recommend this mechanic! The engine in my son’s Mazda died when he came home for Thanksgiving. They tracked down a replacement engine in FL and had it shipped to their shop. Unfortunately that engine had no compression. They handled this situation like true professionals, tracking down a different, significantly new engine at no additional charge. That engine has worked like a charm. The entire time these guys were honest and straightforward. I would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Ashley
reviews.text: John the owner such a nice guy super helpful . I would highly recommend his place, i happen to stumble on his place in need of a alternator and he got me in last min and did a wonderful job. I will be back. So glad I found a honest and trustworthy Mechanic in the Lowcountry. Oh and did I mention very reasonable price!!

reviews.author: Kenny Grubbs
reviews.text: Replacing front half shaft and wheel alignment performed more quickly and less expensively than I anticipated. Fernando and his staff were professional and pleasant. I will use again and have already recommended to a neighbor.

reviews.author: Jonathan Vargas
reviews.text: My family and I were on a road trip to Florida when our car broke down in South Carolina. The team at All In Garage were the only people who were able to help us on that Saturday evening, no other garage in the area was willing to assist. They stayed open for us and waited for us to have our car towed to their location and ordered a piece for us before we got to the shop. Once we arrived they were very welcoming and were able to get us back on the road in no time. The team at All In Garage saved our vacation and really reminded us that there are still good people out there. Their facilities are second to none, we would recommend All In Garage in a heartbeat.

reviews.author: charles grant
reviews.text: Great mechanic shop Excellent customer service, guys did an amazing job looking at my vehicle to ensure that there was no issues. I wasn’t charged at all because they couldn’t find any issues. Great business. Recommended

reviews.author: Mike Pearce
reviews.text: I spent $7000 on a motor rebuild, that was supposed to cost $2500. I got less than 5000 miles out of that rebuild. Took 4 months to complete. It was always something else they needed me to pay for, except for what I personally asked for. I got it back, air conditioning didn't work anymore, wouldn't fix it, the car broke down on me twice, and they charged me for those breakdowns. Now I'm out $7000, with a spun rod bearing. I don't race my car, as I only drive it to work and back. Now I have to buy another vehicle to get to work. It will be hard to trust shops after this. I hope the new owner doesn't do like the previous owner did, and screw customers.

reviews.author: Michael Merriman
reviews.text: Were from out of town. And our air conditioning stopped working. They got us right in. And fixed the problem. And the price was below what i expected. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Matt Drahzal
reviews.text: We were traveling through and had starter problems in our Silverado. Mike and the team fit us into their workday and saved the trip. Their shop is awesome looking and clean, and their cost was so fair I had to ask twice to insure what I was hearing was correct. I was exceedingly pleased!

reviews.author: jack mcgahay
reviews.text: Showed up for my appointment and they were waiting for me. Everything was just as professional and courteous as could be. This was my second visit in 2 weeks. All in Garage services both of my cars. They are the best at what they do.

reviews.author: Frank Delong
reviews.text: HEY YOU! Yes, you with the car problems! Are you looking to pay too much for service, be put on a long wait list, or have your vehicle poorly handled while not in your possession? Well, look everywhere else EXCEPT for this place! Mechanical, electrical, old, or new, they'll do it all for a more then fair price and with the quality you wouldn't even think to expect!

reviews.author: Scott Caldie
reviews.text: Great place for car / truck maintenance. Fair price and 1 hour service. Imagine having an appointment that is honored and you can wait a short time for completion! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Cynthia Head
reviews.text: Thank you once again for AMAZING service at All In Garage! I scheduled service & intended to wait at their office while the repairs were made. The owner suggested that I have someone pick me up because the work would take 3-4 hours. I didn't have anyone to pick me up so the owner loaned me HIS vehicle so that I could go home and wait there while the repairs were being done!!! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Melanie Johnson
reviews.text: I had been to another shop, where they told me the problem was my brakes. After fixing the brakes, the sound continued. I took it to All In and they found the issue quickly. They fixed it, treated me well, and we're extremely honest about every step.

reviews.author: Paul Garvey
reviews.text: Correctly diagnosed and resolved the exhaust sounds from the side pipes on my C2 which I had been trying to get resolved for the last 6 months elsewhere. Listened to the engine, scheduled an appointment for the next week and it was fixed overnight. Knowledgeable about these older vehicles - and honest.

reviews.author: Andy Williams
reviews.text: Takes pride in their work. You never have to worry about greasy finger prints or not prints in or on your vehicle. Very courteous and you are always met with a smile . Very convenient and speedy turn around. The most bang for your buck, not to expensive, very reasonable.

reviews.author: Devon McCurdy
reviews.text: Pete was very accommodating and helpful. Saw me on a Saturday for an alternator swap; got the job done in less than a few hours at almost half the quoted cost of a national chain shop. Cool guy, great work, can't recommend enough.

reviews.author: Al Wynn
reviews.text: Catalytic converter on new motor home was stolen at storage yard. Local Ford dealer declined to work on the F550 Ford chassis motor home. All in Garage quickly ordered new Ford parts and promptly installed new $2600 system that was covered by insurance. Very professional and honest people at this shop.

reviews.author: George Lipsky
reviews.text: All In was professional & very knowledgeable. They listened to my concerns & addressed them. They stuck to the schedule & stayed in touch via phone calls. This was my 1st time there with the new ownership. They resolved 1 issue that the previous ownership did not. I'll continue to use them for our family's vehicles.

reviews.author: Mark Powell
reviews.text: Stopped in for an hour to swap the oil in my 4wd system. Fully equipped workshop, tools, rack lifts and really helpful and friendly owner and staff. If I lived nearby I would definitely use them on a regular basis - too bad I was just passing through

reviews.author: Travis Gearwar
reviews.text: Normally I never use garages for anything but there are a few things I can’t do myself. This place is probably one of the more reasonable places around bluffton/ Hardeeville. They’re straightforward and not trying to swindle everyone. I would recommend these guys over most places around here.

reviews.author: Tom Alsop
reviews.text: Had a great experience getting my 1968 Cadillac DeVille Convertible serviced and repaired. Steve the mechanic knew exactly how to repair the car and did an excellent job. Great Job All in Garage .

reviews.author: Paul Gonzalez
reviews.text: They serviced my f150, both 250 Econolines, and my personal vehicle a Volvo V70. Would not take my vehicles anywhere else. I trust them to give me fair and honest prices. Would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Michele Nizzi
reviews.text: Fernando is not only accommodating , professional and knowledgeable. But also seems to be managing on his own . He could use a good desk person to manage the front. Thank you for being so accommodating. Michele

reviews.author: Jayson Bowers
reviews.text: Went here to lift my Jeep. The mechanics on hand helped me with every problem and the shop was more then well equipped to handle the job. Definitely will be coming back in the future.

reviews.author: Curtis Burchfield
reviews.text: I had an issue that would cause my engine to lose all power while driving. The issue only happened occasionally and never at a safe time. I would be in traffic and have no way of accelerating. The issue would produce no codes, wouldn't happen while at any shop, and no one could determine the problem until Fernando on the second time I brought the vehicle to him talked to some contacts he has and figured out the solution.

reviews.author: Kyle Fischer
reviews.text: While on vacation, the serpentine belt on my Mazda5 somehow got completely frayed. All In Garage fixed it in less than 2 hours. Very satisfied.

reviews.author: Adam Schanne
reviews.text: Rented the garage to do some work that I can handle myself. Must say that this was a great experience and very nice guys in the shop to help give a hand if need be. Affordable for sure and I will be going back for future jobs that I can tackle myself.

reviews.author: Kevin Flynn
reviews.text: All In Garage is the best mechanic shop in the area. High ratings in all categories. Service, reliability, expertise, and price! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Pat Conti
reviews.text: They took care of my car when everyone else was too busy. Fernando, the owner is very nice and honest. Karen, at the front desk, was very helpful.

reviews.author: Thomas McHardy
reviews.text: saved me a bundle - after an other shop told me I needed new shocks and struts, Mike checked them out and told me they were ok. fast, honest service.

reviews.author: Nicholas Rigg
reviews.text: All around phenomenal experience. Very helpful, very professional work. If you're going to take your car anywhere, this is the place to go.

reviews.author: Miguel Lugo
reviews.text: They helped me out on a last-minute issue with no appointment. Explained to me what was wrong, and even showed me.

reviews.author: Dick Kaminski
reviews.text: AIG looked into my concern about a fluid leak. They determined It was the right suspension control arm and also found the left arm to be cracked. Both will be replaced Friday March 1, 2019. More comments after the work is done.

reviews.author: S. Armstrong
reviews.text: I uber up to drive a car friend purchased and when we arrived the owner gets out of his trk and starts running his mouth when he knew we were coming... I told him to "Chill so so I could explain why we're there and he runs off and calls the police..once they arrived they couldn't understand what his problem was...very awkward and never would I give him my business..

reviews.author: Michael Wilson
reviews.text: Great staff. Answered all my questions. Nice waiting room. Both of my vehicles are being maintained by the folks at All In.

reviews.author: Tony Clark
reviews.text: They were able to do what no other shop in the area could. Highly recommended and reasonable rates as well!

reviews.author: Charles King
reviews.text: Looked for a service center similar to what I was used to. John & Kathy seem to be filling the gap. Great service and quality work. Will be back, hopefully only for routine maintenance.

reviews.author: Mike Hankerd
reviews.text: Great service. They go out of their way to take care of customers. One of the nice things about working with a small business.

reviews.author: Mark Haughton-James
reviews.text: Both Fernando and Julio are honest hard working guys who will do their best to get your vehicle serviced or repaired.

reviews.author: Mob
reviews.text: Definitely recommend to people great guy in the front desk. The work was great !! My go to mechanics from now on !!

reviews.author: PeLaura
reviews.text: They are the best. Good customer service and very honest. They get the job done. I will be going back.

reviews.author: Sage Leya
reviews.text: I just needed to share this so hopefully the business will do better with customer service in the future. I brought my car in last week because the engine light came on, it was looked at and the mechanic explained what was most likely happening. I’m not the best with cars but I trusted him and was impressed at first by how much he explained everything. I set up an appointment for this week on Tuesday (I specifically made this appointment day as I was off work and also had someone to come pick me up as the car would’ve taken a while to be done). I was late by an hour but had called ahead before I arrived to see if it was still okay to bring my car in and that was okay they informed me. The shop closes at 5:30 and I hadn’t received a call the entire day. I call the store at about 25 minutes before closing to check on the status of my car, I’m not kidding the mechanic asked ME what I wanted him to do to the car…I was lost for words. I wanted to respond “I don’t know fix it like we discussed and I set this entire appointment for?” I mean that’s how I assumed an appointment worked, especially when I’ve already brought the car in for an initial look. Instead I just asked if anyone had even looked or worked on the car at all the in what almost 7 hours it was just sitting there in the parking lot. And the answer was you guessed it “no”. I go to pick up my car because at this point I don’t even want their services, and the worker apologized by saying sorry we couldn’t get to it today. I’m sorry what? I HAD AN APPOINTMENT. Look things happen but how did I not receive a call or anything?? So they were just going to leave my car overnight there without any call to inform me they didn’t not work on my car at all and they have to do it tomorrow or something? But I had received, silence. So just please do not do this to another customer. The mechanic seemed to be very knowledgeable and I was disappointed by how my car and I myself as a customer were treated with no regard. I’m not saying don’t go here but for your sake I guess call and make sure they’re working on your car even when you have an appointment.

reviews.author: Dilenia Gonzalez
reviews.text: Ever since I got my car, the dealership sent me to him and now I'm a customer. I highly recommend him.
